proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s A B hA hB
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.isDiameter_iff_mem_and_mem_and_dist.mpr ⟨hA, hB, h⟩, fun h => h.dist_left_right⟩
  have h := dist_triangle A s.center B
  rw [hA, EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere'.mp hB] at h
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → dist A B ≤ 2 * s.radius ∧ (dist A B = 2 * s.radius ↔ s.IsDiameter A B)
